name: @dt/database
description: Shared database models, schemas, and migrations for TEMİN 360 App

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/sync-manifests.mjs && tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); function copyYaml(src, dist) { fs.mkdirSync(dist, { recursive: true }); fs.readdirSync(src, { withFileTypes: true }).forEach(entry => { const sPath = path.join(src, entry.name); const dPath = path.join(dist, entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) { copyYaml(sPath, dPath); } else if (entry.name.endsWith('.yaml')) { fs.copyFileSync(sPath, dPath); } }); } copyYaml('src/schema-manifest', 'dist/schema-manifest');"
